source: S3 sourcing pass for The Echo: NARA moving images (federal makers proven on the record) and NARA dates for the Armory stills

fit.beat: echo-x1: the January 1951 withdrawal, refugees in snow
fit.why: Signal Corps film 111-ADC-8634, Uijongbu, 2 Jan 1951 (shot card 1, 4th scene): a 24th Division squad checks a file of refugees passing south, then two soldiers walk the snow-covered ground. The same withdrawal six days before the line's date, near Seoul, not Kangnung: the cut takes the refugee scene only. No in/out yet: the 839 ft silent reel is not viewed (no transcode in this pass); the editor sets in_s/out_s from the shot card's 4th scene.
